seed_rule: Runtime seed must equal 20260801 exactly or strategy construction fails closed.

data_contract.decision_input: canonical RangeIndex DecisionContext bar frames only
data_contract.bar_availability_rule: admit a row only when open_time + 8h <= decision_time; frame index is never a timestamp
data_contract.history_rule: exact contiguous suffix of 126 closed bars on one modal timestamp grid, split into nonoverlapping 105-bar baseline and 21-bar recent windows, with latest close no more than 12 hours stale
data_contract.invalid_observation_rule: nonfinite or nonpositive high, low, or quote volume and high <= low are unavailable, never imputed or floored; require at least 95 baseline and 19 recent valid impact observations per scored symbol

mechanism.unsigned_range: log(high / low) for a valid past-closed bar, capped at 0.70
mechanism.contemporaneous_volume_share: valid symbol quote volume divided by total valid quote volume at the same timestamp; at least 12 valid symbols are required
mechanism.impact_proxy: unsigned log range divided by max(contemporaneous quote-volume share, 1e-5)
mechanism.raw_depth_improvement: log(median baseline impact / median recent impact) over disjoint 105-bar and 21-bar windows
mechanism.score: centered cross-sectional fractional rank of raw depth improvement in [-1, 1]
mechanism.direction_free_rule: price direction, close location, taker-side flow, funding, beta, residual return, shock, trend, reversal, volatility rank, diffusion, and lead-lag are absent
mechanism.selection: A5-returned score chooses the top and bottom k, where k=min(8,max(5,ceil(0.20*N)))
mechanism.sizing: equal weights with 0.18 long and 0.18 short budgets

universe_authority.rule: Only certified native crypto coins and tokens; stablecoins, equities, TradFi, indexes, metals, commodities, and every other non-crypto contract remain excluded even when exchange-listed as perpetuals.

score_adapter.boundary: complete final finite built-in rank-score dict[str,float] after depth-impact transformation and before span checks, selection, role separation, sizing, caps, or organizer risk
score_adapter.label: simple executable-open-to-executable-open return

family_rule: One exact no-control core in final pivot-02. No controls, ablations, sign flips, parameter neighbors, or replacement trials are authorized. A failed core makes Team 05 DNF.
private_data_rule: No private or OOS access is authorized until every development and A5 gate passes and the organizer formally selects the candidate.
